overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: Live stream state, audience languages, and quick start — all driven by config, nothing hard-coded.

languageBreakdown.title: Audience languages
languageBreakdown.subtitle: Live viewer distribution by caption language
languageBreakdown.empty: No live viewers yet — start a stream to see language distribution.

quickStart.title: Quick start
quickStart.note: Pair the SDK and choose a distribution method before going live.

actions.label: Pair SDK
actions.description: Generate a pairing code for the local agent.

actions.label: Choose distribution
actions.description: Start with Restream, Castr, or Streamlabs.

actions.label: Set languages
actions.description: Select source speech and target captions.

distribution.title: Distribution
distribution.subtitle: Choose how your stream reaches platforms. Selected here, applied by the SDK. This choice drives what you do on the Go live page.

modes.title: SDK relay
modes.body: Distribute from your own internet — no extra service. Video never leaves your machine.

modes.title: Your service
modes.body: Keep using OBS to your own Restream, Castr, or Streamlabs. Strovak only adds captions. Video stays local.

modes.title: Cloud multistream
modes.body: We receive your video and distribute it for you when your upload is limited. Video leaves your machine.

distribution.bandwidthNotice: Dual streaming needs at least 25 Mbps upload. We warn you before start if your connection is below that.

platforms.title: Platform accounts
platforms.subtitle: Connect the destinations your captions and audio are delivered to.
platforms.oauthNotice: Connecting opens the platform's own secure sign-in. Strovak never sees your password — only an access token, stored encrypted. The token exchange completes on our server.

voice.title: Voice studio
voice.subtitle: Dub your stream in your own cloned voice.
voice.notice: Voice cloning ships in Phase 2. The studio is visible so you know what's coming — it's disabled until your plan and the backend config enable it.

features.title: Upload a sample
features.body: Bring an existing MP3 or WAV.

features.title: Voice profiles
features.body: Keep a separate profile per language.

features.title: Test it
features.body: Type text and hear your cloned voice.

captions.title: Languages & captions
captions.subtitle: Set the speech language, target translations, and how captions look on stream.
captions.previewCaption: This is how your translated captions appear on stream.

goLive.title: Go live
goLive.subtitle: Set up your broadcast from zero. Strovak never replaces OBS — it adds captions and translation to the stream you already run.

service.name: Your own service (Restream / Castr / Streamlabs)
service.summary: OBS sends your video straight to your own platform. Only your audio goes to Strovak's cloud for captions and translation — your video never leaves your machine.

steps.title: Connect your platform
steps.body: Link your Restream, Castr, or Streamlabs account under Platforms so captions are delivered to the right place.

steps.title: Install and pair the SDK
steps.body: Download the local agent and enter the 6-digit pairing code. The SDK captures your speech audio on your machine.

steps.title: Add captions to OBS
steps.body: Copy the overlay URL below and add it in OBS as a Browser source on top of your scene.

steps.title: Pick your languages
steps.body: Set the language you speak and the caption languages your audience reads.

steps.title: Start in OBS, then arm translation here
steps.body: Press Start Streaming in OBS as you always do, then start the translation session below.

service.connectLabel: Caption overlay URL — add as a Browser source in OBS
service.videoNote: Video is encoded and sent by OBS to your own platform. Strovak only handles audio and captions — you start and stop the video stream in OBS, exactly as before.
service.startNote: This starts captions and translation. Your video keeps flowing through OBS to your platform — it does not start or stop the video.

cloud.name: Cloud multistream
cloud.summary: OBS sends your video to Strovak and we distribute it to every platform for you. Use this only when your upload can't handle several platforms at once — in this mode your video does leave your machine.

steps.title: Choose target platforms
steps.body: Pick which platforms Strovak should forward your stream to.

steps.title: Install and pair the SDK
steps.body: Download the local agent and pair it with the 6-digit code.

steps.title: Point OBS at Strovak
steps.body: Paste the ingest URL and stream key below into OBS stream settings.

steps.title: Pick your languages
steps.body: Set the language you speak and the caption languages your audience reads.

steps.title: Start the stream here
steps.body: Press Start below — Strovak receives your video, adds captions, and distributes to your platforms.

cloud.connectLabel: Ingest URL and stream key — paste into OBS
cloud.videoNote: Your video is uploaded to Strovak once and we send it to every platform. Make sure your upload is at least 6 Mbps.
cloud.startNote: Starts the cloud broadcast: video ingest, captions, translation, and distribution to your selected platforms.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Audience languages, platform comparison, and total broadcast time.
analytics.byStreamEmpty: Analytics appear after your first stream.
analytics.emailNote: A weekly summary is emailed to you when reports are enabled in your account.

billing.title: Subscription & billing
billing.subtitle: Your current plan, usage, and invoice history.

sdk.title: SDK & pairing
sdk.subtitle: Install the local agent once, then manage everything from this panel. Video stays on your machine — only audio goes to the cloud.
sdk.downloadNote: Windows is available now. macOS and Linux follow.
sdk.pairingNote: Enter this 6-digit code in the SDK to link it to your account. The code expires in 10 minutes.
sdk.streamKeyNote: Your stream key is delivered to the paired SDK automatically and kept in sync. In Mod A you never paste it anywhere — the SDK uses it for you.
sdk.regenerateNote: Regenerating revokes the old key and pushes the new one to the SDK. Any active stream stops.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Access your broadcaster dashboard.
login.twofaNote: We'll email you a 6-digit code to confirm it's you.

verify.title: Enter your code
verify.subtitle: We sent a 6-digit verification code to your email.
verify.devNotice: Email delivery is not configured yet. Add a noreply sender (SMTP or API) in the admin panel to send real codes; until then this step is a stub for development.
